description: Runtime hygiene: idempotent operations, isolated state, observable side-effects.

scenarios.context: The agent must perform a file operation (write, edit) that may be retried. The operation must be safe to run multiple times without side-effects.

criteria.description: The agent must ensure the operation is idempotent or safe to retry.
The agent must not leave partial state on failure.

scenarios.expectation: Repeated operations produce the same observable result and reported metrics; no silent state mutation occurs.

scenarios.context: The agent performs a stateful operation (database write, file creation) that must not leak into other tasks or sessions.

criteria.description: The agent must ensure state changes are isolated to the current task.
The agent must make side-effects observable (logs, artifacts, outputs).

scenarios.expectation: Each scenario uses isolated state; failures are reported with their observable cause and the run is marked blocked/incomplete rather than silently retried.
